title: AISF members detained in Itarsi while travelling to Delhi protest
seoTitle: Itarsi AISF members detained en route to Delhi

tea.why: Travelling to Delhi to participate in a demonstration demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner.
tea.want: Demand the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and immediate release of detained students.
tea.changed: Oct 9: Fourteen women AISF members were detained at Itarsi railway station while travelling from Pune to Delhi.

summary: Members of the All India Students Federation (AISF) travelling from Pune to Delhi to attend a demonstration were intercepted and detained by police at Itarsi railway station in Madhya Pradesh. The students intended to participate in a protest demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. According to the organisation, 22 students were taken into custody, while Times of India reported 14 women members were kept in a local hotel under restricted access. AISF alleged that police dragged, beat, and mistreated the students during the intervention. The organisation demanded the immediate release of all detained individuals, accountability for the alleged mistreatment, and disclosure of their whereabouts.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
response: According to the Times of India, authorities placed the detained students in a hotel banquet hall with restricted access while providing food and water. The Daily Pioneer noted that its sources did not include an official response from Madhya Pradesh Police or Railway Police.

arrests.text: 14 AISF women members detained in Itarsi

injuries.text: a woman even injured and bruised her leg

updates.text: AISF reported that 22 students travelling from Pune to Delhi were detained by police at Itarsi railway station.
Times of India reported 14 women members of AISF were intercepted aboard the Goa Express and lodged in a local hotel.
